description:
Sylvia Beach's Shakespeare and Company lending cards (Paris, 1919-1941): who borrowed an author, with the most-borrowed titles and each member's dates; or, for one member, every author and title on their card. A borrow is attested contact with a copy, dated on the card, not proof of reading.

Example questions:
- "What did Hemingway borrow from Shakespeare and Company?"
- "Who borrowed Joyce from Sylvia Beach's library?"
- "What did Gertrude Stein borrow from Sylvia Beach?"

author.description: The author borrowed, e.g. 'Joyce', 'D. H. Lawrence'. With reader, narrows that member's card to this author.

limit.description: How many borrowers or authors to list (default 25).

reader.description: A lending-library member, e.g. 'Hemingway', 'Gertrude Stein', 'Walter Benjamin'.

name: shakespeare_and_company_borrowing
title: Shakespeare and Company lending library: who borrowed what
